messages:
chloe: spotted a dashboard card showing metrics from a different org after a rapid canary switch. looks like a prefetch race; card header shows org:omega but body metrics for org:delta. not secrets but confusing for users.
ryan: can you repro? steps?
chloe: 1) login as user with access to both orgs, 2) open dashboard, 3) quick-switch org A -> org B -> org A in under 700ms, 4) observe summary card.
chloe: traced it to PrefetchRouter: it caches response bundles keyed by `user:route` and reuses them across org switches. snippet from logs:
INFO PrefetchCache hit key=user-42:route=/api/card/summary ownerOrg=delta cached_at=2026-03-20T18:05:00Z
INFO Render start request.org=omega using bundle.ownerOrg=delta
sam: so cache doesn't include orgId. that's the bug. we assumed apiKey->org mapping was stable but multi-org users break that.
ryan: immediate rollback option: disable client prefetch for multi-org users (feature flag: prefetch_multiorg). recommend server-side guard too: if cachedBundle.org != request.org then ignore cache. cheap and safe.
chloe: +1 on guard. also add unit test covering rapid-switch timing.
devops-bot: feature rollout: prefetch_multiorg=true toggled at 2026-03-20T17:50:00Z
ryan: i'll open a hotfix PR to add orgId to cache key and implement the guard. include telemetry counter `prefetch.mismatch` when guard drops.
sam: we'll avoid full rollback unless mismatch spikes. chloe, can you post a quick note to CS about potential transient bad cards while we patch?
chloe: posting now. link to repro gist and logs: https://git.redwood/s/console/repro/1747010000
ryan: PR: https://git.redwood/s/prefetch/patches/1747010000. aiming for canary in 30m if CI green.
chloe: thanks. schedule follow-up in 24h to review telemetry and add a fuzz test to CI for rapid-switch scenarios.
